question: The sum of two numbers is 74 and their difference is 12. Find the product of the two numbers.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Larger number = (Sum + Difference) ÷ 2 = (74 + 12) ÷ 2 = 43

Smaller number = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2 = (74 − 12) ÷ 2 = 31

Product of the numbers = 43 × 31 = 1333

**∴ The correct answer is 1333.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers (x + y) = 74

Difference of two numbers (x − y) = 12

**Formula Used:**

4xy = (x + y)² − (x − y)²

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4xy = 74² − 12²

⇒ 4xy = (74 + 12) × (74 − 12)

⇒ 4xy = 86 × 62

⇒ xy = (86 × 62) ÷ 4

⇒ xy = 43 × 31 = 1333

**∴ The correct answer is 1333.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for Sum of Squares

(a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²)

Difference of Squares

a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)
